description_en: Binds a storage bucket to a sub-application of ApsaraVideo VOD
description_zh: 为视频点播的子应用绑定存储Bucket
kebab_example: aliyun vod add-vod-storage-for-app --app-id app-0000 --storage-location example-bucket.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com --storage-type vod_oss_bucket --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddVodStorageForApp

parameters.help_en: The application ID. The application ID is the value of the `AppId` parameter returned by the [CreateAppInfo](~~CreateAppInfo~~) or [ListAppInfo](~~ListAppInfo~~) operation
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID列表。应用ID为调用[CreateAppInfo](~~CreateAppInfo~~)接口或[ListAppInfo](~~ListAppInfo~~)接口返回参数`AppId`的值
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The OSS bucket address. This parameter is required when StorageType is set to user_oss_bucket
parameters.help_zh: OSS bucket地址。当StorageType为user_oss_bucket时，该字段必填
parameters.name: storage_location

parameters.help_en:
The storage type. Valid values:

- vod_oss_bucket
- user_oss_bucket

Default value: **vod_oss_bucket**
parameters.name: storage_type
